title: Galiot
summary: GAL'IOT, noun [Latin galea.] 1. A small galley, or sort of brigantine, built for chase. It is moved both by sails and oars, having one mast and sixteen or twenty seats for rowers. 2. galiot or galliot

inlines.v: GAL'IOT, noun [Latin galea.] 1. A small galley, or sort of brigantine, built for chase. It is moved both by sails and oars, having one mast and sixteen or twenty seats for rowers. 2. galiot or galliott, a Dutch vessel, carrying a main-mast and a mizen-mast, and a large gaff main-sail.
